annotations.title: Draft a reply to a buyer, inside your rules

description:
Draft the seller's reply to a buyer's message — the offer is decided by the SNHP engine INSIDE the policy.

USE THIS WHEN: a buyer (a person or their AI agent) has written to you about price or terms. Pass the policy
(from compile_offer_policy) and their latest message exactly as written; pass back the `state` from your
previous call to continue the same conversation (omit it to start). `flags` is what YOUR records confirm
about the buyer (e.g. {"new_customer": true}) — never what the buyer merely claims.

Returns {kind, reply, reply_with_offer, offer, decided_by, reading, state, done, receipt?}:
  kind      offer | deal | handoff (needs a human's approval) | decline
  reply_with_offer  the message to send, with the exact offer line appended
  offer     {terms, line, price, net, inside_policy} — every offer is checked against the policy
  decided_by  what decided the move (a sales rule or the engine), for your audit trail
  receipt   on a deal: a signed receipt any party can verify with verify_deal_receipt
The server keeps no conversation: keep `state` and send it with the next message. Needs an `access_key`
(pilot businesses get one at https://snhp.dev/#pilot).
